messages.subject: geom_area stacking problem
parts:
Hi, I'm trying to stack areas using geom_area and in doing so, some x
values stack (those that share same x value) while others do not stack
(none matching x values). Is there a way to make all values stack even
though they do not share the same x values?

my data has the following structure:

keyspeci spp treat block date t_ha
age year
"integer" "integer" "integer" "integer" "Date" "numeric" "numeric"
"numeric"

graph code:

ggplot(all, aes(age, t_ha, group=spp, fill=factor(spp) ) ) +
geom_area() + facet_grid(keyspeci~block)

Any input would be greatly appreciated.

Best,

Gerardo
